userOnboardingIntro: Create the user first, choose a global role, then grant real workspace access by inviting them to projects. Per-user work directories are no longer configured here.
onboardingIdentityDesc: Set display name, affiliation, User ID, and initial password.
onboardingRoleDesc: Choose whether this is an admin/operator or a normal member/viewer.
onboardingProjectInviteDesc: A member's actual file access is determined by project membership.
accessDerivedFromRoleAndProjects: Derived from role and project membership
accessDerivedHint: At signup, set only the account and global role. Grant project access from the project menu's invite/member management.
accessWorkspaceWideDesc: Admin/operator roles can work across the whole workspace.
accessProjectBasedDesc: Works only inside invited projects. Add members from the project menu.

purpose.openai: Used for image generation, slide creation, and AI-powered content production.
purpose.firecrawl: Used to read web pages, search the web, and collect research.
purpose.apify: Used for external crawling tasks such as fetching YouTube transcripts.
purpose.naver: Used for news, blog, and web searches through the Naver Search API.
purpose.google: Accesses Google Workspace data. Project-specific access is safer for personal or organizational data.
purpose.ssh: A key that can access servers. Enabling it by default for every project is risky.
purpose.aligo: Used to send text messages. Project-specific access is safer because of cost and accidental-send risk.
purpose.default: A connection used to access an external service.

usageScope.allProjects: Enabled by default for all projects
usageScope.none: Not used by any project yet

warning.inherited: Enabled by default in {{count}} projects. This describes the impact scope, not a problem.
warning.disabledPolicies: Policy rows remain in {{count}} projects, but the connection itself is disabled.
